annotations.title: Hand in a slip or supplier invoice

description: Hand in a receipt, till slip, fuel slip or supplier invoice (PDF or photo, base64, max 10 MB). It is read immediately and filed under Slips & Documents for the business to check and post — nothing is posted to the ledger by this tool. Returns what was read. Use when the user gives you a slip or invoice file to hand in. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.
